points.text: A fire broke out at Adolf Hitler’s former Eagle’s Nest retreat in Bavaria, and police detained a suspect.
The U.S. intelligence chief warned that Iran has increased efforts to target U.S. personnel and that plots against Americans have advanced.
A collision between two Philippine Air Force planes during a training flight killed four pilots.
Gunmen opened fire during a funeral at a church in Jordan, killing people and injuring dozens; authorities increased security and searched for the attackers.
Protests over school funding and the cost of living continued in France, where police used tear gas and major Paris museums closed.
